help.title: How to use this portal
help.intro: Menus and action buttons appear based on your account permissions. If you do not see an action, you may not have access to it.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.body: Use the left sidebar to open pages you can access. Collapse or expand the sidebar with the menu button in the header.

listPages.title: List pages
listPages.body: On list management pages, use the toolbar to search, create, refresh, and open the recycle bin. Select rows when bulk actions are available.

contextMenu.title: Context menu
contextMenu.body: Right-click a table row to open the context menu for actions such as edit, delete, restore, or move up/down. On the resource tree page, right-click a tree item the same way.

recycle.title: Delete and restore
recycle.body: Soft-deleted records can be restored from the recycle bin. Permanent deletion cannot be undone.

appearance.title: Theme and language
appearance.body: Toggle light or dark theme from the header. Change language from the user menu in the top-right corner.
